summary: Discretize an axisymmetric rectangular coil cross-section into ordered cylindrical R-Z filament locations, with an optional in-plane rotation about the section center.

identity.relation: rectangular coil section to ordered circular-filament coordinates
identity.direction: coil geometry parameters -> filament R-Z locations
identity.definition: Creates nr by nz uniformly spaced points with Z as the inner source-order index, then optionally applies the maintained row-vector rotation convention about (r0,z0).
identity.model: geometric discretization without a magnetic-field model
identity.geometry: axisymmetric rectangular coil cross-section represented by circular filaments
identity.boundary: all generated cylindrical radii must remain nonnegative
assumptions: nr and nz are positive integers
dr and dz are positive finite center spacings

inputs.name: nr
inputs.constraints: Positive integer; booleans and fractional values are rejected.

inputs.name: nz
inputs.constraints: Positive integer; booleans and fractional values are rejected.

inputs.name: angle_deg
inputs.description: In-plane rotation using the maintained row-vector sign convention.

outputs.name: rz_pts
outputs.constraints: Radii are nonnegative; unrotated ordering is radial outer loop and axial inner loop.

preconditions: The rectangular section and its rotated points do not cross the cylindrical axis.
supported: Uniform rectangular cross-section discretization for axisymmetric circular-filament models.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for nonfinite centers/angle, invalid counts/spacings, or geometry crossing R=0.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: No partial result is returned when validation fails.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this operator has no iteration.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel implementation with frozen internal admission evidence; private review identifiers are not part of the public contract.

python.signature: discretize_rectangular_coil(r0, z0, nr, nz, dr, dz, angle_deg=0.0)

example.description: Generate a two-by-three unrotated filament grid and verify its maintained ordering.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.field import discretize_rectangular_coil
points = discretize_rectangular_coil(1.0, 2.0, nr=2, nz=3, dr=0.4, dz=0.2)
np.testing.assert_allclose(points, [[0.8, 1.8], [0.8, 2.0], [0.8, 2.2], [1.2, 1.8], [1.2, 2.0], [1.2, 2.2]])
example.expected: A float64 array with shape [6,2] in radial-outer, axial-inner order.

scope: Invalid count, spacing, and axis-crossing failures.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Verified against the maintained SciRel contract for finite axisymmetric rectangular sections; this does not validate a physical winding or field solution.
known_limitations: Only uniform center spacing is supported.
Rotation is confined to the R-Z cross-section.
Public distribution licensing remains pending a human decision.
